description:
Cross-org sharing entry (R9.5, R9.6).

Mirrors ``sharing_grant`` table. The grantee is exactly one of
``grantee_org_id``, ``grantee_space_id``, or ``grantee_user_id``;
the ``CHECK`` constraint at the DB layer enforces "at least one"
but the API model is stricter — exactly one — so clients cannot
construct ambiguous grants.

created_by.description: User id of the org_admin who created the grant.
created_by.title: Created By

expires_at.description: Optional expiration; ``null`` means the grant is open-ended.
expires_at.title: Expires At

grantee_org_id.description: When the grantee is an entire organization.
grantee_org_id.title: Grantee Org Id

grantee_space_id.description: When the grantee is a specific space.
grantee_space_id.title: Grantee Space Id

grantee_user_id.description: When the grantee is a single user (admin convenience).
grantee_user_id.title: Grantee User Id

granter_org_id.description: The org granting access. Always set.
granter_org_id.title: Granter Org Id

title: SharingGrant
